capabilities: create named settings profiles with selectable setting categories
switch between profiles from a status bar icon or command
share profiles across vaults via a configurable folder path
auto-sync active profile when settings change
save or load current settings to and from a profile
disambiguation: Not a note-sync tool; it shares app settings between vaults, not note content.
extras: README announces a refactoring in progress and requests feedback; the profile save path must be configured separately for each vault and device, and the plugin needs permission to write files outside the vault.
problem: Obsidian stores all settings per vault, so configuring themes, plugins and hotkeys must be repeated manually in every new vault.
summary: Settings profile manager that saves themes, plugins, hotkeys and other settings into named profiles shared across vaults.
